Went public via a blank-check merger months ago. Charismatic founder-CEO. Winner-shaped narrative: decarbonize trucking without waiting for depot charging.
recent_developments: Still $0 of recognized revenue. Management guides first Hybrid revenue in the back half of the year and year-end demos of the flagship long-haul architecture.
Ten Hybrid units installed in the latest quarter — deployments, not sold-and-recognized volume.
